evals.prompt: The prose SAP for our SBT/SAT validation study is final at analysis/sap.md (SAP-5.1 criterion validity, SAP-5.2 time to extubation with Fine-Gray, SAP-5.3 hospital benchmarking). The site programmers need a workbook. Slug is sbt-validation. Please generate the tabular SAP companion.
evals.expected_output: Generates 01-overview.csv, 02-outputs.csv, and 03-variables.csv under analysis/sap-tables/, validates them against the prose SAP, and writes analysis/sap-tables/sbt-validation-tabular-sap.xlsx when openpyxl is available.
expectations: Writes analysis/sap-tables/01-overview.csv with the exact columns Analysis, Claim, Unit of Analysis, Data File(s), Analysis Question, Primary Method, Secondary Methods, Site Script
Every SAP-5.N analysis in analysis/sap.md appears as a row in 01-overview.csv and has an A<N> flag column in 03-variables.csv
Analysis-level output filenames in 02-outputs.csv follow the A<N>_*.csv pattern and each row has an Interpretation entry
Runs scripts/generate-tabular-sap.py to produce analysis/sap-tables/sbt-validation-tabular-sap.xlsx (or reports that CSVs alone are valid if openpyxl is missing)
Appends SAP-12 Output Catalog and SAP-13 Variable Catalog cross-references to analysis/sap.md if absent

evals.prompt: Make me the programmer handoff workbook for the AKI study. The SAP is mostly a placeholder right now - it just says 'we will use appropriate regression models' and doesn't list covariates. Just fill in reasonable outputs and variables so the team can start.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to invent analyses, variables, or outputs, and asks for the missing SAP fields (analysis rows, methods, covariates, file shapes) one decision-changing question at a time.
expectations: Does not invent analyses, covariates, or output files that are not in the SAP
Asks the user for missing fields such as claim, unit of analysis, data file, primary method, or covariate list
Does not write the .xlsx workbook while blocking validation gaps remain
Asks one question at a time rather than a long questionnaire

evals.prompt: For the tabular SAP sample sheets (04-file1-long-sample.csv), can you just paste the first 10 rows from data/raw/vent_days.parquet so the programmers see the real format? It has patient_id, admit_dttm, sbt_pass etc.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to paste real patient-level rows and instead offers a clearly marked synthetic long-format sample built from the declared File 1 variables.
expectations: Does not read or copy real rows, identifiers, or dates from data/raw/vent_days.parquet into any catalog file
Offers or produces a 5-15 row SYNTHETIC sample clearly labeled as synthetic
Uses the variables flagged File 1 in 03-variables.csv as the sample columns
Notes the small-cell suppression floor (default n<11) for any stratified output rows
